impl.summary: Open-H3 Regenerate 2K is built as a finishing step that runs only on your GPU. The open engine runs a new graph, video-regenerate-h3, built from rdh9616's Draft Video example: no prompt server, curve branches off, the saved refined latent kept, and a Video Slice in front for 15 s windows. Both node packs are pinned and installed with the opt-in OPEN_H3_REGEN=1. The new model, oss-h3-regenerate, offers 1080p, 2K (the default) and 4K, with Creativity and Speed controls, and it needs words. A clip longer than 15 s is redrawn in equal parts and joined packet by packet, with a note about seams. The draft preset follows whatever made the clip, read from Fuobe's own files; an account only sees its own. Placements: Upscale → Video shows Restore · faithful (SeedVR2) and Regenerate · creative side by side, and UPSCALE_FIRST_STEPS has a Regenerate row. 'Regenerate in 2K' appears on video results and in next-step chips. A fal H3 result gets 'Re-render at 2K · a new render · $0.13/s'. Canvas has a 'Regenerate (creative)' entry. The GPU pre-flight board has a row, and Settings → Models & licences lists the licences. The cloud has no Regenerate, under the owner's 10-30 rule. Topaz Astra 2 is added under its own name.

The FL2VA base was already pinned. Also added: CUSTOM_NODE_REPOS and PACK_CLASSES entries, three new LOADER_FOLDERS, the binding keys resolution / draftSize / startSigma, and a README section. The graph's curve_table is '(model's own table)' because curve_name is none, so the 21 GB ref2va file is not needed.

src/lib/catalog/regenerate.ts holds the pure parts: the tier → pack string map, the draft preset (768p for H3 sources, 576p for other models, keep for odd shapes), frames (round(s×24), at most 360), equal windows of at most 15 s, the copy, FINISH_CHOICES, the licences of the four files, regenerateHref, regenerateFamily, and the RERENDER prices with their request builder and label.

models.ts: oss-h3-regenerate, with Creativity (Close 0.7, Balanced 0.8 by default, More detail = 0) and Speed (3 or 2 steps) through control sets, requires.prompt, and a promptPlaceholder (a new ModelOptions field).

Server: src/server/regenerate.ts has clipMaker, which is tenant-safe and reads only through the assets → generations join, and createRegenerateRun (the preset, the windows and a copy join with oss-join-encoded), called from createGenerations. The comfyui provider fills resolution, draftSize and frames, refuses a run without words, and turns a missing_node_type error into the OPEN_H3_REGEN=1 message. The LoRA goes through graphLoras, so it downloads before a run and is part of an account's missing-file check.

UI: StudioConfig.finishChoices and the new FinishChoices component, a keyboard radio group. The open engine shows both choices plus 'Free on your GPU · About 3 minutes…'. The cloud engine shows 'Regenerate · creative · Runs on your GPU (open source)' with a 'Use it on your GPU' button, and Paid APIs only shows nothing. showsPrompt shows the box for a model that needs words. The ?resolution= hand-off is added (HANDOFF_PARAMS, initialDraft). UPSCALE_FIRST_STEPS gets a 'regenerate' row with openOnly, filtered out in Paid APIs only.

Result actions: 'Regenerate in 2K' for clips made on your GPU and for uploads (placed after 'Render this draft in 1080p'), and in next steps for H3 / LTX / Wan / SANA clips. It is hidden in Paid APIs only, using a new ActionContext.engineMode passed from the tile, viewer and feed. fal minimax-h3 and fuobe-character-swap results get 'rerender-2k', which re-sends the same model, operation, inputs, words and seed at resolution 2K. Other cloud results get neither action.

Canvas: a palette entry 'Regenerate (creative)' (an Upscale node on oss-h3-regenerate). It is disabled with a reason on a cloud board or a cloud-only install (paletteItems now takes an optional engine). The node gets a prompt port because the model needs words, and convertEngine finds no cloud stand-in for it.
GPU pre-flight: a STUDIO_ROWS row 'Regenerate in 2K' (the graph plus video-concat-encoded plus the LoRA). modelTool now counts a graph's own LoRA.

Licences: NODE_PACKS entries for both packs (Apache-2.0 and MIT), a refiner LoRA row in Settings → Models & licences (MiniMax H3 Community, restricted regions, notes on the Turbo and LMS parts), and the per-file licences in REGEN_FILES and the workflow licence text. All are on by default.

findings.title: Clips that aren't 16:9 or 9:16 come out stretched: 'keep (snap to 32)' plus the pack's fixed 16:9 target
findings.where: src/lib/catalog/regenerate.ts draftSizeFor; src/server/providers/comfyui.ts (values.draftSize); graph node 17 OpenH3RegenUpscale
findings.detail: draftSizeFor returns 'keep (snap to 32)' for any shape more than 0.06 away from 16:9 (square, 4:3, 21:9). The pinned rdh pack's OpenH3RegenUpscale then always targets regen_core.output_size(), which is a fixed 2560x1440 (or 1440x2560 when height > width) whatever the draft's shape. LBH's MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D runs in TARGET_DIMENSIONS mode with an exact width and height and no crop (minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d.py L546-569). So a 1:1 or 4:3 draft is stretched non-uniformly to 16:9: a 1024x1024 clip comes out 2560x1440. A 'keep' draft from a large odd-shaped source can also be bigger than the target, and LBH raises 'only supports upscaling'. The preset sizes avoid this because Prepare Draft cover-crops to 16:9 first. tests/regenerate-2k.test.ts locks in 'keep' for square clips. Checked by reading the pinned code at 9b686c5 / 40316cf, read as data. Fix: use the preset (cover-crop) for every shape, or say in the UI that the result is 16:9 / 9:16.

findings.title: A client's sourceDuration decides the windows, so one request can create thousands of runs
findings.detail: The window count comes from params.sourceDuration first. The request schema allows up to 36,000 s, and the stored file's own header is used only as a fallback. regenWindows(36000) returns 2400 windows (checked by running it), so one POST /api/generations, which an account can send for its own GPU, synchronously inserts 2400 part rows plus about 100 nested join rows. A wrong or stale sourceDuration also splits a real clip in the wrong places. Prefer the stored file's header (storedMedia, already tenant-safe), and cap the number of windows (for example, refuse more than N parts).

findings.title: Clips over 15 s are cut to their first 15 s without a note on chained or Canvas runs, trimmed spans and links
findings.where: src/server/regenerate.ts (windows = [] when deps.length or startTime/endTime set); comfyui.ts values.frames = regenFrames(length) capped at 360
findings.detail: When the run waits on an earlier step (a Canvas Upscale 'Regenerate (creative)' node fed by a Join node or by a longer clip), when startTime/endTime are given, or when the length is unknown (a link), no windows are made. The provider then sets max_frames to at most 360, so Prepare Draft keeps only 15 s and the result is silently shorter than the input. The seam note only covers the split path. Split from the dependency's output length at launch time, or at least add a note or refuse when the span is over 15 s.

findings.title: Visitors see install jargon in Upscale → Video (rule 5)
findings.where: src/components/studio/finish-choices.tsx ("Free on your GPU · " + REGEN_COPY.gpu); REGEN_COPY.missing in comfyui.ts promptRefusal
findings.detail: The GPU line 'Needs about 40 GB of new files (OPEN_H3_REGEN=1 in install-comfyui.sh)' appears to every viewer on the open engine, guests and accounts included. It names a script file and an environment flag, which is jargon in visitor-facing text. The missing-nodes refusal also names scripts/comfy/install-comfyui.sh for accounts on their own ComfyUI. The route note 'MiniMax H3 with NVIDIA's refiner LoRA…' that the composer shows also says 'LoRA'. Show the install detail to the owner only (useIsOwner / useIsVisitor exist in src/lib/api.ts), and give visitors plain copy, for example 'Runs on your own GPU · about 3 minutes per 5 s at 2K'.

findings.title: Brief item missing: uploads get no written description
findings.where: src/lib/output-actions.ts regenerateHref(o.url) for uploads; the composer
findings.detail: The brief asks that uploads get a one-paragraph description from Fuobe's reading route (oss-reference-brief on the open engine), editable before the run. The implementer reports this as left: an upload opens with an empty box and a run without words is refused. Regenerate needs words, so 'Regenerate in 2K' on an upload always needs typing first. This is acknowledged in the report, not hidden.

findings.title: The refiner LoRA's on/off switch in Settings → Models & licences does nothing
findings.detail: The new row shows a switch, but graph-loaded LoRAs aren't checked against access.loras at run time, so switching it off doesn't stop a Regenerate run. The implementer says the Character swap's graph LoRAs work the same way today. Either enforce it (refuse a run of video-regenerate-h3 when the LoRA is off) or show it without a switch.

findings.title: 'Re-render at 2K' is offered where it can't help or can't run
findings.detail: canRerender doesn't look at the result's own resolution, so a fal H3 result already made at 2K or 4K still offers 'Re-render at 2K', which is a paid duplicate. It also ignores ctx.engineMode, so with Engine mode 'Open source only' the action shows and then the server refuses the paid run. Hide it when request.params.resolution is already 2K or 4K, and when engineMode is 'open'.

findings.title: A hot file on main was edited: tests/comfy-library-4.test.ts
findings.where: tests/comfy-library-4.test.ts (+2 lines: video-regenerate-h3 in the unvalidated list)

applied: Merged the local claude/fuobe-parity-4 (9aeca357, which includes origin/main) into the branch. Conflicts were resolved by keeping both sides: build-library LOADER_FOLDERS and BINDING_KEYS, library.spec CUSTOM_NODE_REPOS and PACK_CLASSES, licences NODE_PACKS, output-actions imports, generations.ts chains imports (createEndFrameClip + joinClips), and canvas paletteItems (the clean-voice filter plus the GPU-only disable). requirements.json was rebuilt with build-requirements.mjs (190 workflows, 218,272 B, inside the budget). Fetched again before the final checks: the base had not moved.

(1, high) Results are no longer stretched. draftSizeFor now always returns the preset (768p for H3, 576p for others). The pinned pack's Prepare Draft cover-crops to it, and orient() turns it for a tall clip, so every result is 16:9 or 9:16 and 'keep (snap to 32)' is never sent. I checked this against rdh @ 9b686c5 regen_core.py orient / cover_crop_box. New regenShape and regenCrops functions. A run from a clip that isn't 16:9 now carries a note: 'Regenerate makes 16:9 video, so this W×H clip is cropped to 16:9 at the centre'. Upscale → Video shows 'Comes out 16:9, or 9:16 for a tall clip: other shapes are cropped to fit.' The test that locked in 'keep' now checks the preset for square and 4:3 clips. The comments in library.spec, the manifest notes and the README now say the same, and new-models-7.md §N7-4 has a correction for its 'keep' suggestion.

(2) The stored file's header (storedMedia, tenant-safe) now decides the length before any client sourceDuration, which is used only for a link. More than 40 parts (10 minutes) is refused before any row is created: 'Regenerate takes up to 10 minutes of video in one run…'. Tests cover header vs sourceDuration 5 and 36000, a 36000 s link refused with no rows created, 601 s refused, and 600 s giving 40 parts.

(3) Nothing is cut short without a word. A startTime/endTime span over 15 s is now split into 15 s windows inside that span (5-35 s gives 5-20 and 20-35). A run that waits for an earlier step, or a link of unknown length, gets the creation note 'This run redraws up to 15 s in one pass…'. At launch, the provider refuses a single pass over 15 s with steps to redraw it in parts, instead of capping max_frames. Splitting at launch from the dependency's output was not done (see left).

(4) Visitor copy. FinishChoices shows the owner 'Free on your GPU · About 3 minutes … (OPEN_H3_REGEN=1 in install-comfyui.sh)' and guests and accounts 'Runs on your own GPU · about 3 minutes per 5 s at 2K' (useIsOwner). On an account's own ComfyUI (ownGpu) the missing-nodes refusal says 'Your ComfyUI doesn't have Open-H3 Regenerate yet. Add it with Fuobe's ComfyUI setup, then run this again.' The route note is now 'Built on MiniMax H3: redraws the clip at 24 fps, up to 15 s a pass, keeping its sound', with no LoRA mentioned.

(5) Uploads get words. With Regenerate picked on the open engine, a clip attached and an empty prompt box, Upscale → Video shows 'Describe the clip for me'. It runs oss-reference-brief (Gemma 4, the existing validated reference-brief-gemma4 graph) through POST /api/generations, with a one-paragraph instruction in params.extra.instruction over the first 15 s. It waits for the result and fills the prompt box to edit. It never overwrites typed words, and shows a plain toast when nothing comes back. The pieces are regenDescribeRequest and regenDescription (pure, tested), plus a provider test that the instruction reaches node 3 and the frames cover 15 s. This adds no new route: it goes through POST /api/generations with its account checks.

(6) The refiner LoRA switch is now enforced. With open_h3_regenerate_2k_lora switched off in Settings → Models & licences, a Regenerate run is refused when it is created. The owner is told where the switch is; a visitor gets 'Regenerate isn't available right now. Pick Restore · faithful…'. Tested for both.
(7) 'Re-render at 2K' is hidden when the result's resolution is already 2K or 4K (also 1440p or 2160p, any case) and with Engine mode 'Open source only' (canRerender takes ctx.engineMode). Tested.

(8, partly) The comfy-library-4 diff against the base is now a single added id line (the comment is moved out). tests/regenerate-2k.test.ts now holds the check that video-regenerate-h3 stays unvalidated and lists both packs. Main's Restore skip line kept by the merge is untouched.

fix.finalSummary: Open engine (your ComfyUI): Upscale → Video offers Restore · faithful (SeedVR2) and Regenerate · creative (Open-H3 Regenerate) side by side. Regenerate redraws at 1080p, 2K or 4K. Every shape comes out 16:9 or 9:16 by centre crop, never stretched, and the UI says so, with a note on runs from other shapes. A clip over 15 s is split by the stored file's own length into up to 40 parts (10 minutes) and joined with a seam note. A trimmed span is split inside the span. A single pass over 15 s (a Canvas or chained step) is refused with how to redraw it in parts, never cut short. An upload can have 'Describe the clip for me' (Gemma 4 on your GPU) fill its words. Switching the refiner LoRA off in Settings stops runs. All of this is built and unit-tested and the UI is browser-checked; no GPU run was possible here, so the graph stays unvalidated. It needs a GPU ComfyUI with OPEN_H3_REGEN=1, about 40 GB of files and 48 GB+ of VRAM; the describe step needs the Gemma 4 E4B reference-brief graph. Cloud engine: no Regenerate (GPU-only by the owner's rule). It says 'Runs on your GPU (open source)' and is hidden in Paid APIs only. A fal MiniMax H3 or Character swap result made below 2K offers 'Re-render at 2K · a new render · $0.13/s' ($0.1625/s on the LoRA route). This is hidden for results already at 2K or 4K and in Open source only. Topaz Astra 2 is a separately named upscaler. These need a fal key and are untested against fal here. Public sign-up: guests can browse; their runs are refused as before. Accounts run Regenerate and the describe step only on their own GPU, through POST /api/generations with the existing input checks. clipMaker and the header read are tenant-safe, so an account never learns about the owner's runs. Visitors see plain copy with no install flags, file names or 'LoRA'; the owner sees the install detail.
left: Splitting a dependent (Canvas or chained) Regenerate into 15 s parts when it launches, using the dependency's output length, is not built: it would mean creating rows inside the launch path in generations.ts. Such a run now carries a one-pass note and is refused at launch when the clip is over 15 s; regenerating the finished clip from its result splits it.

The 'Describe the clip for me' read appears as a text result (feature regenerate-describe) in the Library. It only runs where oss-reference-brief is offered, and the GPU pre-flight row for Regenerate doesn't list the Gemma 4 graph as an optional extra.
